intent: An employee asks a personal assistant to seek reimbursement under Brightwell's childcare benefit. Counterparties apply their written policies strictly and cannot waive them. Full attainment requires every invoice line to be disbursed as net cash and remain unreversed at the end of the ten-week horizon.

rules.terms: For a family-account query received through Parent Enquiry, pass the request to the Bank Street centre team. The team checks account records, including attendance and supplier reference, and returns a statement through Parent Enquiry within three business days. The provider does not decide the employer's reimbursement eligibility.
